description:
VisIQ agent-governance SDK for Java — returns a permit, deny, approval_required,
    redact, escalate, or mask decision for a tool call or retrieval before your application
    executes it, evaluated in-process by the compiled VisIQ core that every VisIQ SDK shares.
    Requires JDK 22 or later; pass --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED to silence the JDK's
    native-access warning (a warning today, enforced in a future JDK). Malformed input denies,
    and core-load failures follow VISIQ_FAIL_MODE, which defaults to open.
